CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2639 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head b79c3d4f69bb603ec559ceb2f19f974c917b72f3. Bus nonce: 369e5c9b438daa3ce602c8037eff8aa2. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin b79c3d4f69bb603ec559ceb2f19f974c917b72f3`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge b79c3d4f69bb603ec559ceb2f19f974c917b72f3` or `Fix review: blocked b79c3d4f69bb603ec559ceb2f19f974c917b72f3 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 369e5c9b438daa3ce602c8037eff8aa2`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2639 b79c3d4f69bb603ec559ceb2f19f974c917b72f3") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2639-369e5c9b`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer, PR #2639 (tvofi/heatpump_optimizer), R10-FLY-GH-READ-RETRY PR 2 of 2, round 2: merge_train.py's and record_row.py's GitHub reads, and app_approve.sh's JWT installation read, retry under one bounded rule (gh_read.py). Head b79c3d4f69bb603ec559ceb2f19f974c917b72f3. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head. Re-read the head first; if it moved, the verdict is blocked.

Round 1 was refused at the opener: instrument-self-tests was red at 5907408d (check-run 120184592953), with two failures main does not have:
- merge_pr self-test, "FAIL null control: the merge records the reviewed head (STALE: a re-run did not clear #42's head)";
- pr_args self-test, "FAIL the pusher census: the rule returns exactly the dispositioned paths, and every runner reaps".
Check:
1. The round-2 fix names the cause in the code (not by inference) for each, and fixes it architecturally: the new path is DISPOSITIONED in the census rule, not the census loosened; the merge_pr null control is still honest (it must still go red when a re-run fails to clear the head). Mutate each fix back and show the self-test turns red; run your own mutants too.
2. The retry rule itself: bounded (a fixed number of attempts with a cap), retries only transport errors and 5xx, never 4xx or a refusal, and never retries a write. Plant a 404 and a 500 against gh_read.py and show each takes the right arm; mutate the bound away and show a check fails.
3. instrument-self-tests is green at this head in CI (read check-runs, one bulk read); every touched instrument's self-test passes; structure.py passes; merges clean with origin/main (git merge-tree --write-tree).
4. Body: figures re-taken at this head; carry_audit (tools/audit/carry_audit.py pr 2639) reads 4 routed, 0 unrouted, 0 bad; ## Red checks answers every red.
5. Say whether any path is code-owned (tools/pr/app_approve.sh is not on main's CODEOWNERS list as far as I read; confirm).

ev/HEAD.txt must hold the full 40-hex head sha, or the relay refuses the verdict.
Do not add Claude Code footers, Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers or any claude.ai session link to commits, verdicts or comments.
